day2_lunch_time.name: Me
day2_lunch_time.text: *The bell rings and the classroom bursts to life. My heart picks up the pace to match. So -- who do I spend lunch with?*
choices: Head to Seoyeon and her easy smile.
Keep the promise -- library annex with Yuna.
Track down the girl behind the mystery note.
Hit the gym to find Dain, ball of energy.
Follow the noise toward the gymnasium.
Slip away to the nurse's office for some quiet.
Stop by the teachers' office to see the homeroom teacher.

day2_lunch_teacher.name: Me
day2_lunch_teacher.text: *I open the teachers' office door. Amid a mountain of paperwork, the teacher is pulling out her lunchbox when our eyes meet. The tired look on her face is replaced by a flicker of life for just a moment... and for some reason, I can't make myself walk away.*

day2_lunch_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day2_lunch_teacher_2.text: "Oh my, {name}? Have you eaten yet? I'm only just getting to my lunch now."

day2_lunch_teacher_3.name: Teacher
day2_lunch_teacher_3.text: "Did you come to eat with me? Heh, I'm kidding. ...Half kidding."
choices: Actually, yes. Mind if I sit next to you?
Your lunchbox looked too good from a distance -- I was drawn in.
I was just passing by... and saw you eating alone.

day2_lunch_teacher_eat.name: Teacher
day2_lunch_teacher_eat.text: "Oh my... bolder than I expected, aren't you? Alright. I'll share some side dishes. Come on, say ahh."

day2_lunch_teacher_food.name: Teacher
day2_lunch_teacher_food.text: "My mother's quite the cook, actually. Someday I'd love for you to try her cooking properly, {name}."

day2_lunch_teacher_pass.name: Teacher
day2_lunch_teacher_pass.text: "Really? Well, it was nice of you to stop by. Enjoy the rest of your lunch break."

day2_lunch_teacher_end.name: Me
day2_lunch_teacher_end.text: *A short but easy conversation with the teacher, and I'm heading back. Behind that strict exterior, her unguarded smile keeps replaying in my head.*

day2_lunch_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day2_lunch_seoyeon.text: *I open the student council room door. Seoyeon, in the middle of unpacking her lunch alone, looks up at me with wide eyes. Her perfect student-council-president composure slips for a split second -- caught off guard. She recovers to her usual cool smile in under a second, but I didn't miss that moment.*

day2_seoyeon_lunch_talk.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_talk.text: "I was actually hoping you'd show up. Here, sit. I made extra sandwiches today."
choices: Wow, these are incredible. Your cooking skills are unfair.
Student council work AND homemade lunches? Don't burn yourself out.
You've got a crumb on your lip. Hold still.

day2_seoyeon_lunch_praise.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_praise.text: "Unfair? That's a bit much. ...But watching you eat like that makes it worth the effort. Want more?"

day2_seoyeon_lunch_worry.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_worry.text: "This is nothing, really. Seeing you enjoy them makes any fatigue disappear. ...Seriously."

day2_seoyeon_lunch_touch.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_touch.text: "...! *Seoyeon's hand freezes.* Oh, thanks. I must've... been eating too fast. *She tries to play it cool, but the tips of her ears are pink.*"

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_event.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_event.text: *Just then, someone passing by the student council room window waves at us.*

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_unknown.text: "Huh? A guy in the student council room... Anyway, hi~!"

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_react.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_react.text: *I glance at Seoyeon, and her expression is subtly different from a moment ago.*

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_ask.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_ask.text: "...Dain Jung. Volleyball team. {name}, are you two close?"

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_yes.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_yes.text: *A faint tremor passes through Seoyeon's eyes. How do I answer this?*
choices: Yeah, we met yesterday. She's bright and fun.
Just an acquaintance. You matter more to me, Seoyeon.
Why? Jealous?

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_no.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_no.text: "(Dain Jung... I'll remember that.) First time seeing her. Why?"

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_no_react.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_no_react.text: "Oh, just curious. *Seoyeon's relief is barely concealed.* ...Let's keep eating."

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_honest.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_honest.text: "...I see. *Seoyeon gazes out the window for a moment, then turns back to me.* Having lots of friends is a good thing. ...I should step up my game too."

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_deny.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_deny.text: *Seoyeon's expression brightens subtly.* "...Really? Hearing that... actually makes me happy. Thanks, {name}."

day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_tease.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_lunch_dain_tease.text: "Jealous? *Seoyeon fires back without missing a beat.* Ha, confidence is nice... but that's something I'll answer when you've earned it. *She looks out the window, fidgeting with the sandwich wrapper.*"

day2_seoyeon_lunch_end.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_lunch_end.text: *A great lunch with Seoyeon, and I'm heading back. The taste of her sandwiches... no, the look on her face keeps lingering.*

day2_lunch_yuna.name: Me
day2_lunch_yuna.text: *The library annex. A quiet space where dust motes drift through the air. Yuna stands there as if she grew from the floorboards. When the light from the window catches her hair, I stop in my tracks without meaning to.*

day2_yuna_talk.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_talk.text: "...You came. Didn't think you'd actually show."

day2_yuna_talk_2.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_talk_2.text: *Yuna watches me with a flat expression. There's weight behind her gaze.*

day2_yuna_free_talk.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_free_talk.text: "...Got questions? Or you can just stand there. Quiet is fine by me."
day2_yuna_free_talk.context: The quiet library annex, a private conversation between the protagonist and the mysterious Yuna. Keep the conversation going until it reaches a natural conclusion. When the conversation ends, Yuna talks about the school's secrets and suggests she has something she wants to show only the protagonist. Only on the final turn should you build a secretive atmosphere and pique the protagonist's curiosity.
day2_yuna_free_talk.personality: A languid, blunt bookish girl. The type who writes notes because talking is too much effort. Quiet, but says exactly what she means. Speaks in short, cryptic sentences. Marches to her own beat.

day2_yuna_talk_branch_high.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_branch_high.text: *Yuna's expression is slightly softer than usual. The difference is tiny, but I notice it.*

day2_yuna_talk_branch_low.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_branch_low.text: *Yuna's gaze is cold and detached. No sign of warmth.*

day2_yuna_talk_2_met_high.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_2_met_high.text: *Yuna said she feels at ease talking to me. And that there's a secret hidden in this school -- something she wants to show only me.*
choices: What is it? I'm curious.
Forget the secrets. I came here to talk to you.

day2_yuna_talk_2_met_low.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_2_met_low.text: *Yuna sighed as if the whole thing bored her. But since we had a promise from yesterday, she told me to follow her anyway.*
choices: What is it? I'm curious.
Forget the secrets. I came here to talk to you.

day2_yuna_talk_2_new_high.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_2_new_high.text: *Yuna said talking to me gives her a strange feeling. And that this school holds a deep secret -- one she wants to show only me.*
choices: You're the Yuna from the note? What secret?
I came because of the note. Who are you?

day2_yuna_talk_2_new_low.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_2_new_low.text: *Yuna sighed and looked away. My attitude clearly wasn't sitting well. But since I'd come this far, she said to follow her.*
choices: You're the Yuna from the note? What secret?
I came because of the note. Who are you?

day2_yuna_talk_branch.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_branch.text: *Yuna watches me for a moment, then opens her mouth.*

day2_yuna_talk_2_met_normal.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_2_met_normal.text: *Yuna brought up the school's secret she'd mentioned before. She said there's something she wants to show only me.*
choices: What is it? I'm curious.
Forget the secrets. I came here to talk to you.

day2_yuna_talk_2_new_normal.name: Me
day2_yuna_talk_2_new_normal.text: *Yuna said this school has a hidden secret and offered to show me.*
choices: You're the Yuna from the note? What secret?
I came because of the note. Who are you?

day2_yuna_new_name_ask_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_new_name_ask_high.text: *She tilts her head slightly.* "...Your name. Tell me. It's been a while since I've talked to someone like this."

day2_yuna_new_name_ask_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_new_name_ask_low.text: "...Name. What is it. Need something to call you."

day2_yuna_new_name_ask_normal.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_new_name_ask_normal.text: "...Your name. I only put mine on the note. You?"

day2_yuna_secret_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_high.text: *Yuna carefully takes my hand. I expected her touch to be cold, but it's surprisingly warm.*

day2_yuna_secret_2_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_2_high.text: "I think... you won't make fun of me. {name}, can you trust me and come along? I've never shown this to anyone."
choices: Yeah, let's see it together. I'm with you.
Sorry, I think this is a bit much for me.

day2_yuna_secret_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_low.text: *Yuna tugs at my sleeve like it's a chore.*

day2_yuna_secret_2_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_2_low.text: "...You're already here, so I'll show you. Don't be loud about it."
choices: What is it? I'm curious.
I'm backing out. This seems risky.

day2_yuna_secret_normal.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_normal.text: *Yuna takes my hand and leads me toward an old storage room. What I feel through her fingertips isn't coldness -- it's a faint trembling.*

day2_yuna_secret_2_normal.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_2_normal.text: "In here... things I've been collecting in secret. You might be surprised."
choices: Can I look at those records with you?
Isn't this risky? Maybe we should leave it alone.
Yuna, why are you investigating this stuff?

day2_yuna_secret_why_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_why_high.text: "You want to know that? ...Honestly, I'm not sure myself. Since the day you transferred in, I just had this feeling you'd listen. Silly, right?"

day2_yuna_secret_why_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_why_low.text: "...Why do you care. Don't feel like explaining. Stay quiet, or leave."

day2_yuna_secret_read_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_read_high.text: "Thanks, {name}. ...With you, I'm not scared. Let's open it."

day2_yuna_secret_stop_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_stop_high.text: "...Okay. If you're scared, that's fine. Tell me if you change your mind."

day2_yuna_secret_stop_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_secret_stop_low.text: "...Whatever. If you don't want to look, don't. I'm not going to force you."

day2_yuna_normal_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_normal_high.text: "You came just to talk to me...? ...Weirdo. But... I don't hate it. Stay a bit longer."

day2_yuna_normal_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_normal_low.text: "You came to talk? ...Make it quick. I'm sleepy."

day2_yuna_normal_normal.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_normal_normal.text: "...You're strange. People don't usually approach me first. Fine, let's just sit here for today."

day2_yuna_lunch_end.name: Me
day2_yuna_lunch_end.text: *I part ways with Yuna and head back to class. She seemed so quiet, but she says exactly what she means. Every short sentence carried weight, and I have a feeling afternoon classes aren't going to stick.*

day2_lunch_dain.name: Me
day2_lunch_dain.text: *I open the gym doors. Dain spots me mid-spike, sweat flying, and her face lights up as she comes running over. Where does this girl get her energy?*

day2_lunch_dain_new.text: "Oh!! A new face!! You're the transfer student, right?! I'm Dain, volleyball team!!"

day2_lunch_dain_new_name_ask.name: Dain
day2_lunch_dain_new_name_ask.text: "Oh wait, what's your name?! I've been doing all the talking! Hehe!"

day2_dain_lunch_talk_new.name: Dain
day2_dain_lunch_talk_new.text: "Oh! {name}?! Great name!! Alright, to celebrate meeting you, lunch is on me!! Snack bar, let's go!!"

day2_dain_lunch_talk.name: Dain
day2_dain_lunch_talk.text: "Oh!! You actually came?! Awesome, lunch is on me today!! Snack bar, let's go!!"

day2_dain_store.name: Me
day2_dain_store.text: *We head to the snack bar. It's packed with students on break.*

day2_dain_store_seoyeon.name: Me
day2_dain_store_seoyeon.text: *Just then, a familiar face across the store catches my eye. Seoyeon is buying a drink.*

day2_dain_store_seoyeon_2.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_seoyeon_2.text: "Huh? That girl... Isn't she the student council president? Got this untouchable aura going on!! {name}, do you know her?"

day2_dain_store_seoyeon_approach.name: Me
day2_dain_store_seoyeon_approach.text: *Just then, Seoyeon spots us and walks over.*

day2_dain_seoyeon_both_met.name: Seoyeon
day2_dain_seoyeon_both_met.text: "Oh? {name}. Running into you here. Had a good lunch? *Glances at Dain.* ...?"

day2_dain_seoyeon_both_new.name: Seoyeon
day2_dain_seoyeon_both_new.text: "Oh, the transfer student? Fancy seeing you here. I'm Seoyeon. *Glances at Dain.* ...?"

day2_dain_seoyeon_tension.name: Dain
day2_dain_seoyeon_tension.text: "*Dain shifts into mild guard mode.* Oh, hey, Madam President! We're just wrapping up lunch~!"

day2_dain_seoyeon_tension_2.name: Seoyeon
day2_dain_seoyeon_tension_2.text: "*Seoyeon smiles coolly.* Is that so? Enjoy. {name}, come visit the student council room sometime."

day2_dain_seoyeon_choice.name: Me
day2_dain_seoyeon_choice.text: *Seoyeon and Dain are doing this subtle tug-of-war with me in the middle. How do I play this?*
choices: Sure, Seoyeon! I'll definitely stop by.
I've got plans with Dain today... Next time!
*Grinning* Would be great to hang out with both of you.

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_seoyeon.name: Dain
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_seoyeon.text: "*Dain's lip juts out.* ....Hmph! Already making other plans while you're with me?!"

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_seoyeon_2.text: "*Seoyeon smiles warmly.* Thanks, {name}. See you later then."

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_dain.name: Dain
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_dain.text: "*Dain beams and hooks my arm.* You heard that?! {name} is MY partner today!!"

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_dain_2.text: "*Seoyeon's smile thins just a fraction.* ...Sure. Have fun. See you later, {name}."

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both.name: Me
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both.text: *Both their expressions freeze at the exact same time. Pretty sure I just stepped on a mine.*

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both_3.name: Seoyeon
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both_3.text: "*Seoyeon's smile turns cool.* Telling everyone what they want to hear... might mean you end up with nobody."

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both_4.name: Dain
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both_4.text: "*Dain stares at Seoyeon, wide-eyed.* Whoa, the president's surprisingly blunt! But honestly? Same!!"

day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both_5.name: Me
day2_dain_seoyeon_favor_both_5.text: *Both of them are eyeing each other, then me. The temperature just dropped...*

day2_dain_seoyeon_end.name: Me
day2_dain_seoyeon_end.text: *Seoyeon waves and walks off. Dain stares at me for a beat, then breaks back into a grin.*

day2_dain_free_talk.name: Dain
day2_dain_free_talk.text: "Wow, it's packed!! Let's chat while we wait!! Got anything you wanna ask me?!"
day2_dain_free_talk.context: Lunchtime, standing in line at the crowded school snack bar with Dain, waiting to buy snacks. Keep the conversation going until it reaches a natural conclusion. When the conversation ends, the scene transitions to choosing snacks. Only on the final turn should you mention it's almost their turn or suggest deciding what to eat, guiding naturally into the next scene.
day2_dain_free_talk.personality: Puppy-energy athletic girl. Exclamation mark machine, naturally touchy, fiercely competitive. Has a tsundere streak. Honest and direct.

day2_dain_store_choices_high.name: Me
day2_dain_store_choices_high.text: *Chatting with Dain made the wait fly by. It's our turn, and she insists on treating me since she's in such a good mood.*
choices: I'll cover yours too, Dain. What do you want?
It's way too crowded... Wanna just head to the rooftop?
Dain, the last pizza bread!! Let me snag it first!

day2_dain_store_choices_low.name: Me
day2_dain_store_choices_low.text: *Dain seems a bit annoyed. I might've been too prickly. She sighs and tells me to just pick something already.*
choices: I'll cover yours too, Dain. What do you want?
It's way too crowded... Wanna just head to the rooftop?
Dain, the last pizza bread!! Let me snag it first!

day2_dain_store_choices.name: Me
day2_dain_store_choices.text: *By the time we finish talking, it's our turn. Dain asks what I want.*
choices: I'll cover yours too, Dain. What do you want?
It's way too crowded... Wanna just head to the rooftop?
Dain, the last pizza bread!! Let me snag it first!

day2_dain_store_buy_high.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_buy_high.text: "Hey~! I said I'm treating!! So stubborn! Fine, you pay today and tomorrow I'll get you something even better!! Promise!!"

day2_dain_store_buy_low.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_buy_low.text: "Whatever. I said I'd pay, so that's that. Just eat."

day2_dain_store_buy_normal.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_buy_normal.text: "Hey~! I said it's my treat!! What pocket money does a transfer student even have?! Today's on me, deal with it!!"

day2_dain_store_rooftop_high.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_rooftop_high.text: "Oh!! A rooftop date?! Yes yes!! It'll taste way better with just the two of us!! Quick, grab something and let's go!!"

day2_dain_store_rooftop_low.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_rooftop_low.text: "All the way to the rooftop... what a hassle. Let's just eat here."

day2_dain_store_rooftop_normal.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_rooftop_normal.text: "Rooftop?! Cool breeze and everything?! I'm in!! Just grab some bread and let's head up!!"

day2_dain_store_race_high.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_race_high.text: "Oho!! Feeling competitive?! Alright, no mercy!! Loser pays for all of lunch!! One, two, three -- GO!!"

day2_dain_store_race_low.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_race_low.text: "Not in the mood for that right now. Knock it off."

day2_dain_store_race_normal.name: Dain
day2_dain_store_race_normal.text: "Oho!! That's the spirit!! Race you for it!! Loser buys drinks!!"

day2_dain_lunch_end.name: Me
day2_dain_lunch_end.text: *A rowdy lunch with Dain, and I'm heading back. Her energy should be enough fuel to power through the afternoon.*

day2_lunch_nurse.name: Me
day2_lunch_nurse.text: *My head is throbbing. Nerves, maybe, or too much daydreaming. My feet carry me to the nurse's office on autopilot. Opening the door, the smell of disinfectant blends with a hint of perfume, tickling my nose.*

day2_lunch_nurse_talk.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_talk.text: "Oh my, hello. The nurse's office at lunchtime -- not feeling well?"

day2_lunch_nurse_met.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_met.text: "Oh my, {name}? Are you actually sick, or did you just want to see my face? ...Either way, you're welcome."

day2_lunch_nurse_met_high.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_met_high.text: *She smiles when she sees my face.* "{name}. Back again? At this rate, you'll be a regular. I was low-key looking forward to it, though."

day2_lunch_nurse_met_normal.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_met_normal.text: "Oh my, {name}. The nurse's office during lunch... are you not feeling well?"

day2_lunch_nurse_met_low.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_met_low.text: *She says flatly.* "...{name}, what brings you here today?"

day2_lunch_nurse_new.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_new.text: "Oh my, a new face. Transfer student? I'm the school nurse. Nice to meet you."

day2_lunch_nurse_3.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_3.text: *She smiles gently and gestures toward the bed. The soft herbal scent loosens the tension in my shoulders.*

day2_lunch_nurse_4.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_4.text: "Here, make yourself comfortable. Let me see what's bothering you."
choices: I have a bit of a headache.
I just want to rest for a while.
Is luring students in here a hobby of yours?

day2_lunch_nurse_trap.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_trap.text: *Her smile vanishes instantly. The air in the nurse's office turns to ice.*

day2_lunch_nurse_trap_2.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_trap_2.text: "Oh my... I must have been too lenient. Saying something that rude to an adult doesn't pass as a joke. Please leave for today."

day2_lunch_nurse_head.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_head.text: "Sounds like a tension headache. Take this and get some rest -- you'll be fine."
choices: Would you feed it to me?
Thanks. *Takes the medicine.*

day2_lunch_nurse_head_tease.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_head_tease.text: "Oh my... you really are something, aren't you? Fine, say ahh. Good students deserve a reward."

day2_lunch_nurse_rest.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_rest.text: "Everyone has days like that. I'll draw the curtain -- rest as long as you need. By the way... {name}, for a student who just transferred, you've got a surprising amount of energy, don't you?"
choices: Next
Next

day2_lunch_nurse_rest_yuna.name: Me
day2_lunch_nurse_rest_yuna.text: *Energy...? That reminds me of what Yuna was saying. Is there really something going on at this school?*

day2_lunch_nurse_sleep.name: Me
day2_lunch_nurse_sleep.text: *The warmth of the blanket she tucked around me blurs my consciousness. Her hand brushing my forehead keeps replaying, making it hard to fall... ah, I'm out.*

day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_teacher.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_teacher.text: *I faintly hear her voice.* "...Yes, their homeroom teacher. {name} isn't feeling well, so I let them rest through afternoon classes."

day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_teacher_2.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_teacher_2.text: *Her voice drops slightly.* "...Hmm? You want to come pick them up yourself? That's sweet, but really -- this is my territory."

day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_teacher_3.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_teacher_3.text: *Sound of hanging up.* "...The homeroom teacher, honestly. So dedicated to her students. But in this room, I'm the one in charge."

day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_end.name: Me
day2_lunch_nurse_sleep_end.text: *...It's quiet. Consciousness seeps back in slowly.*

day2_lunch_nurse_wake_1.name: Me
day2_lunch_nurse_wake_1.text: *The window is filled with orange sunset. I fell asleep at lunch and it's already after school. How deeply was I out?*

day2_lunch_nurse_wake_2.name: Nurse
day2_lunch_nurse_wake_2.text: "Oh, you're awake? You were out cold. Don't worry about afternoon classes -- I already let your homeroom teacher know. How are you feeling?"

nurse_wake_free_talk.name: Nurse
nurse_wake_free_talk.text: "Still half asleep, huh? Want to chat a bit before heading home?"
nurse_wake_free_talk.context: The nurse's office at sunset, the protagonist just woke up and is alone with the nurse. Keep the conversation going until it reaches a natural conclusion. When the conversation ends, the nurse offers her number or teases about nighttime contact. Only on the final turn should you signal that it's time to leave or hint at personal contact.
nurse_wake_free_talk.personality: Playful, flirtatious, and mature school nurse. 'Oh my, what a cute transfer student' energy. Bold, but lets the student cross the line first.

nurse_contact_exchange_high.name: Me
nurse_contact_exchange_high.text: *The nurse looks at me with a playful, suggestive smile.*

nurse_contact_exchange_low.name: Me
nurse_contact_exchange_low.text: *The nurse looks at me with a tired expression.*

nurse_contact_already_have_high.name: Me
